hook.name: FewV4ShellHook
hook.description: Ring Protocol shell hook that routes every swap on the shell pool to the corresponding FewToken lp pool: beforeSwap performs an atomic wrap/swap/unwrap against the lp pool and returns the full fill as a beforeSwap delta, so the shell pool is never the execution venue. Swaps revert if no lp route or inventory is available. hookData is ignored; a transferable owner may register explicit lp pool mappings.
